dict.string: Daily 10:30 local (ADR-107): fixes every GitHub issue a person filed against stuinfla/ruvnet-brain that the night's time budget allows, each in its own linked worktree of its own clone under ~/.cache/ruvnet-brain, and ships all fixes that pass verification and the security gate as ONE release through the protected release gates. The job is OFF unless the repository variable ISSUE_AUTOFIX is exactly "on", and it halts itself (halt file) after any red once main has moved. It holds no publish operation. If the Mac is asleep at 10:30, launchd runs it once on wake; caffeinate holds it awake while it runs. Wrapped in job-heartbeat.sh (positive confirmation, see config/scheduled-jobs.json): JOB_MAX_SECONDS is 10 hours, the registry's maxRunHours (internal budget 9.5 h, of which 3.5 h is reserved for the release). The job runs from its OWN runner worktree, ~/.cache/ruvnet-brain/autofix-runner, pinned to the newest install-verified release (scripts/issue-autofix-runner.mjs installs it at arming and advances it after each run) - never the owner's checkout, which it never touches. Nothing installs this agent: loading it is the arming step in ADR-0107.
